scene: The wet origami unfolds into a shimmering transit pass across Pixel City.
picture: A flat side view of a rainy stone plaza. On the left, a tiled subway entrance leads downward under neon signs. In the centre, the young Black woman in yellow raincoat holds a glowing folded paper ticket. Up high, a suspended cable car hangs from thick cables. On the right, a red street tram waits.
shown: A glass-domed cable car waiting open on an elevated wire up high
A tiled subway stairwell with an illuminated neon train sign on the left
A red street tram stopped with open doors on rails on the right
